newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 19.775 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TIIE 28-day rate rises to 19.775 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate for Wednesday, July 30, was fixed at 19.7750 percent, or a rise of 16.00 basis points from 19.6150 percent, the rate for July 29, Banco de Mexico said on Tuesday.

The 28-day TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate that is revised each working day, and is valid for the day after it is set. The new rate will be published in Wednesday's edition of the Mexican government's Official Gazette.
